pathway: Fallon Medicare Plus / NaviCare / PACE: ICD and S-ICD per NCD 20.4 Nationally Covered Indications
heading: Coverage criteria for implantable cardioverter defibrillators are fully established by Medicare for beneficiaries who meet coverage criteria in section B. Nationally Covered Indications, under Indications and Limitations of Coverage.

pathway: Fallon Medicare Plus / NaviCare / PACE: ICD as a bridge-to-transplant for UNOS-listed heart transplant candidates (Plan determination)
heading: For beneficiaries who are candidates for heart transplantation on the United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) transplant list awaiting a donor heart, coverage of implantable cardioverter defibrillators, as with cardiac resynchronization therapy, as a bridge-to-transplant to prolong survival until a donor becomes available will be determined by the Plan.

pathway: Fallon Medicare Plus / NaviCare / PACE: extravascular (substernal) ICD, Aurora EV-ICD, per NCD 20.4
heading: Extravascular Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators ... The FDA approved the Aurora™ extravascular ICD (EV-ICD) system, is covered effective October 20, 2023 for Fallon Medicare Plus, NaviCare and PACE plan members in accordance with NCD 20.4 Implantable Cardiac Defibrillators (ICDs)

pathway: Endovenous ablation (thermal and nonthermal) of lower extremity superficial truncal or perforator veins — InterQual
